fullList: the full list in full screen
noAreasNote: Without chosen areas the list shows only those that asked for a place and were accepted.
askNote: Other areas can ask for a place on this list — requests go to “Matters” of the person who runs the page.

list.use: Events, groups, parishes or courses of the chosen areas as cards (date, place, picture, “Registration open”); others can ask for a place on the list.
list.sTitle: heading of the list; empty — the name of the kind (“Events”, “Groups” …)
list.sType: what the list shows: "event" — events (usually), "group" — groups, "organisation" — parishes and organisations, "course" — courses
list.sAreas: areas the list takes cards from (ids) — easiest to choose in the editor; empty — only cards accepted on request
list.sDeep: "yes" — also areas within them (usually), "no" — only these areas
list.sKind: only cards of this category (e.g. "rekolekcje"); empty — all
list.sWhen: "coming" — upcoming and ongoing, for groups, parishes and courses: active (usually); "past" — past or archived; "all" — all
list.sLimit: at most this many cards (1–200); empty — 24

one.label: Profile card
one.use: The profile card of one area — an event, group, parish or course: picture, name, description, date, “Sign up”, after the end “After the event”; chosen here or given in the page address (?wydarzenie=…).
one.sTitle: heading above the card; empty — no heading
one.sArea: the area whose profile card to show (id) — easiest to choose in the editor; empty — the area from the page address (?wydarzenie=<id>)
one.empty: A profile card will appear here — choose an area in the module settings or give it in the address (?wydarzenie=…).
one.none: This area has no profile card or it is not public.
one.heading: Heading (optional)
one.note: Empty choice: the page shows the profile card of the area given in the address, e.g. #/strona?wydarzenie=<area id> — one page for many.
one.showsStrip: Name, date, kind and “Registration open” in one line.
one.showsTall: A large picture, name, date, place, description, organiser, “Sign up” (after the end “After the event”) and who is responsible for the content.
one.showsSide: Picture beside: name, date, place, description and “Sign up”.
one.showsBlock: Picture, name, date, place and “Sign up”.
